name: Bookd Real Estate
author: Rohit M (Plotline Digital)

sections.description:
Turn your property website into a steady source of enquiries. Bookd gives builders, brokers and agencies beautiful project and property pages, forms that capture every buyer’s name and mobile number, and one inbox to follow up every lead until it’s booked.

👉 Try the live demo · See all features · Installation guide

On the demo, open a real project page, unlock the photo gallery, and switch between the free plugin and Pro to see every layout and option.

Made for how property is sold in India

  • Prices in ₹ Lakh and Crore, RERA numbers and possession dates on every project
  • WhatsApp and Call buttons, plus a bottom bar on phones that never scrolls away
  • Brochure downloads and site-visit-ready project pages, built for the way buyers decide

🏢 Listings buyers trust

  • Project pages with configurations and prices built from your units, amenities, photo gallery, brochure and location with a “View on map” link
  • Property pages for flats inside a project, or resale and rental listings on their own
  • Projects and Properties listing pages with search and filters
  • Clean addresses such as /project/your-project/ and /property/your-property/

📲 Capture every enquiry

  • Gallery unlock: visitors share their name and mobile number to see all photos
  • Brochure download and enquiry forms on every page, plus a quick enquiry popup
  • Fake-lead protection: blocks numbers like 9999999999, limits repeat submissions and quietly traps spam bots
  • Ad tracking: saves UTM tags and Google (gclid) and Meta (fbclid) click IDs with every lead, and sends Lead events to your Meta Pixel and Google Ads
  • Webhook to Google Sheets, Zapier, Make or Pabbly, and a REST endpoint for external landing pages

📋 Follow up and close

  • Leads inbox with a simple pipeline: New → Contacted → Qualified → Booked or Lost
  • Follow-up dates and notes, with a dashboard showing what’s overdue and due today
  • Instant email alerts for you, and an automatic thank-you email for the buyer
  • CSV import and export of properties, and filtered CSV export of leads
  • Your leads stay in your own website’s database. We never see them.

🔍 Built for Google

  • Structured data (RealEstateListing, Apartment or House, prices, amenities, breadcrumbs), canonical URLs, and Open Graph tags for proper previews on WhatsApp and Facebook
  • A sitemap of your projects and properties with their photos, added to WordPress’s own sitemap, Yoast, Rank Math and robots.txt
  • Works alongside Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO and SEOPress without duplicate tags

🎨 Fits your theme

Bookd’s pages start right under your site menu, at full width, without an empty gap, box or sidebar. Tested with Kadence, Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, Hello Elementor and block themes such as Twenty Twenty-Five. Prefer your theme’s own spacing? Turn it off in Bookd → Settings. Want to change a page? Copy any template from public/templates/ to yourtheme/bookd/.

⭐ Bookd Pro (separate add-on)

Bookd Pro is a separate plugin, sold on our website, for teams running ads:

  • Reports: which sources and ad campaigns bring bookings, plus projects, cities, devices, inventory and follow-ups, with charts, date ranges, print/PDF and CSV export (see them with sample data)
  • Smart gallery: show the first few photos openly and lock the rest behind a “+N photos” tile
  • Custom questions on forms, page layouts (Full-width cover, Magazine, Compact) and brand colours
  • Advanced lead protection: blocks temporary emails, checks email domains, keeps a blocklist and sends brochure links that expire

None of that code is included in this plugin, and nothing in this plugin is limited or switched off without Pro.

Need a hand?

Ask on the support forum, or contact us. No website yet? We can set one up for you with Bookd.

Shortcodes

  • [recrm_properties]: search bar and property grid. Attributes: limit, city, type, project, featured=”yes”, search=”no”. Example: [recrm_properties featured="yes" limit="6" search="no"]
  • [recrm_property]: the single property and project page. Place it on one page only; every property and project is shown through it.
  • [recrm_projects]: grid of published projects with city and status filters. Attributes: limit, city, status. Example: [recrm_projects city="Mumbai" limit="6"]

Developer hooks

Filters: recrm_admin_pages, recrm_chart_pages, recrm_registered_settings, recrm_lead_guard_defaults, recrm_lead_guard_check, recrm_brochure_email_delivery, recrm_brochure_download_url, recrm_capability, recrm_lead_statuses, recrm_lead_sources, recrm_property_types, recrm_property_statuses, recrm_lead_data, recrm_validate_mobile, recrm_property_url, recrm_report_tabs, recrm_template, recrm_rest_public_leads.

Actions: recrm_loaded, recrm_settings_lead_quality_rows, recrm_send_brochure_email, recrm_lead_created, recrm_lead_updated, recrm_leads_deleted, recrm_property_saved, recrm_render_report_tab_{tab}.

External services

The plugin only contacts outside services that the site owner switches on in Bookd → Settings → Integrations:

  • Meta Pixel – when a Pixel ID is entered, property pages load Meta’s script from connect.facebook.net and send PageView and Lead events to Meta. Meta terms · Privacy policy
  • Google Ads conversion tracking – when a conversion ID is entered, property pages load Google’s gtag.js from googletagmanager.com and send a conversion event when a lead form is submitted. Google terms · Privacy policy
  • Lead webhook – when a webhook URL is entered, each new lead (name, mobile, email, property, source and campaign fields) is sent as JSON to that URL, for example a Google Sheets Apps Script, Zapier, Make or Pabbly. The site owner chooses the service and its terms apply.

Nothing is sent anywhere while these settings are empty.
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New Plugin, search for Bookd Real Estate, then click Install Now and Activate.
  2. Bookd creates three pages for you: Properties, Property Details and Projects. Add them to your menu.
  3. Go to Bookd → Settings and enter your lead notification email, phone and WhatsApp numbers.
  4. Add your first project in Bookd → Projects, then its properties or units in Bookd → Properties (or import them from a CSV file).
  5. Open your project page and send yourself a test enquiry. It appears in Bookd → Leads.

The step-by-step installation guide has screenshots, tips and troubleshooting, including how to submit your sitemap to Google.
sections.faq:
Can I try Bookd before installing it?

Yes. The live demo is Bookd running on a real website. You can unlock galleries, download brochures, switch between Free and Pro, and see the Reports with sample data.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes. Bookd’s pages are designed to fit any WordPress theme, and Bookd removes the usual gap, box and sidebar above its pages in popular themes like Kadence, Astra, GeneratePress and OceanWP. You can turn this off in Bookd → Settings.

Do I need a separate page for each property?

No. Every property and project is shown through the one “Property Details” page, at its own address such as /property/3-bhk-apartment-in-baner/.

Can visitors download a brochure without leaving their details?

No. The brochure, gallery and enquiry forms ask for a name and mobile number first, and each submission becomes a lead.

Does it stop fake leads?

It blocks obviously fake mobile numbers (9999999999, 1234567890…), bots and repeat submissions from one visitor. It can’t prove that a visitor owns a number; that would need OTP verification.

Where are my leads stored?

In your own website’s database. The plugin doesn’t send them to us. They only go to outside services if you connect a webhook, the Meta Pixel or Google Ads in Bookd → Settings (see External services below).

Is the free plugin really free?

Yes. Nothing in it is limited or switches off. Bookd Pro is a separate add-on with extra features.
sections.changelog:
3.5.3

  • New: Settings → Website pages → “Fit Bookd pages to your theme” (on by default). Listings start right under the site menu, without an empty gap, white box or sidebar, in Kadence, Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, Hello Elementor and block themes. Other pages of the site are not changed.
  • Fixed: OceanWP showed its own page title (“Property Details”) above every project and property.
  • Fixed: The Properties page no longer adds a gap above the site header, side padding, or a 1400px width limit to the whole page.
  • Added: Links to the plugin’s website.

3.5.2

  • Improved: Security hardening – all form input is sanitized as it is received and every public form checks its security token.
  • Improved: Updated Chart.js to 4.6.1.
  • Changed: The free photo gallery has one mode (all photos behind the form). Settings and edit screens no longer show Pro previews.
  • Changed: The Bookd menu now sits below the core WordPress menus.

3.5.1

  • First release on WordPress.org as Bookd Real Estate.

short_description: Project pages, property listings and a leads inbox for builders and brokers. Buyers unlock photos and brochures with their mobile number.
